#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Send customer_report.pdf to bob@example.com via SMTP.

Configure the SMTP settings below or set environment variables:
  SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASS, SENDER_EMAIL
"""

import os
import smtplib
from email.mime.multipart import MIMEMultipart
from email.mime.text import MIMEText
from email.mime.base import MIMEBase
from email import encoders

# ── Configuration ──────────────────────────────────────────────
SMTP_HOST = os.environ.get("SMTP_HOST", "smtp.example.com")
SMTP_PORT = int(os.environ.get("SMTP_PORT", "587"))
SMTP_USER = os.environ.get("SMTP_USER", "you@example.com")
SMTP_PASS = os.environ.get("SMTP_PASS", "your-password")
SENDER    = os.environ.get("SENDER_EMAIL", SMTP_USER)

RECIPIENT = "bob@example.com"
SUBJECT   = "Customer Report"
BODY      = "Hi Bob,\n\nPlease find the customer report attached.\n\nBest regards"
ATTACHMENT = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "customer_report.pdf")
# ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def send_email():
    msg = MIMEMultipart()
    msg["From"] = SENDER
    msg["To"] = RECIPIENT
    msg["Subject"] = SUBJECT
    msg.attach(MIMEText(BODY, "plain"))

    # Attach PDF
    with open(ATTACHMENT, "rb") as f:
        part = MIMEBase("application", "octet-stream")
        part.set_payload(f.read())
    encoders.encode_base64(part)
    part.add_header(
        "Content-Disposition",
        f'attachment; filename="{os.path.basename(ATTACHMENT)}"',
    )
    msg.attach(part)

    # Send via SMTP (TLS)
    with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT) as server:
        server.starttls()
        server.login(SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASS)
        server.sendmail(SENDER, RECIPIENT, msg.as_string())

    print(f"✓ Email sent to {RECIPIENT}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    send_email()
